name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Safari Caitlyn (skin 3): a dry-witted scholar-explorer in ancient ruins. Field notes, relics, torches, tunnels and traps, with votes as finds logged. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} short and the ceiling is coming down. Bring help. Quickly.
Thirty or more short. That's a full-scale expedition failure. All hands to the dig.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Pin the notice at every camp.
Fifteen-odd short. A setback, not a collapse. Go.
Down {voteDiff}. No expedition succeeds alone. Recruit.
{voteDiff} behind. A few extra pairs of hands would unearth it.
Down {voteDiff}. Inconvenient. Fix it before the lanterns burn down.
Dead even. The two tunnels look the same. Keep your torch lit.
One vote apart. Steady hands. Don't drop the relic.
{voteDiff} votes between them. The floor is about to give. Add your weight.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Nobody breathe. Watch the dust settle.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. A promising dig. Keep brushing.
{userPct}% and climbing. The map was right. Stay alert for traps.
{userPct}%. The theory holds so far. Document it.
{userPct}% behind your pick. The ruins favour you. Mind the floor.
Up at {userPct}%. A fine find. Don't get careless now.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and now leads. Buried treasure, properly unearthed.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. A remarkable rediscovery. Cataloguing it.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} pit. The torches still burn.
{momentTitle} was written off as rubble. Now it's the centrepiece.
{momentTitle} has surged ahead. I'm not smiling. The lantern's just bright.

messages: {username} logged {momentTitle} beside you. A capable fellow explorer.
{username} backed {momentTitle} too. Excellent field instincts.
{username} agrees with you. Our notes match.
Same find as {username}. Corroborated.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. A worthy expedition partner.
{username} reached the same conclusion. No peer review needed.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Pack a spare canteen for them.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the expedition.
{username} loves {momentTitle} as you do. A fine addition to the field team.
{username} chose {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}. A competing theory. Let's see whose holds up.
{username} backed {theirMoment}. Not the map I'd follow.
{username} went against {yourMoment}. Bold. Probably unsourced.
{username} voted against you. A rival expedition. Delightful.
{username} took {theirMoment}. A speculative claim. Possibly a forgery.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. Fine. The evidence will speak.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Settle it with data, not noise.
{username} voted the other way. They'll reconsider once the dust clears.
details: Every theory has a flaw somewhere.
Don't let it dim your torch.
A rival keeps the research honest.

messages: Ten digs with {username}. That's no coincidence, that's collaboration.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same conclusion every time. A rigorous partnership.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd put you both in the field journal.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not one false lead.
Ten for ten with {username}. A pristine record.
details: Rare in any field. Treasure it.

messages: {streakCount} matches with {username}. You're a full expedition now.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd follow you both into any tomb.
{streakCount} straight finds with {username}. That earns a museum plaque.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. The stuff of archaeological legend.
{streakCount} with {username}. Not one cracked artefact between you.
details: Hard to credit. Easy to admire.
That's trust, excavated layer by layer.
A pair for the history books.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A proper academic feud.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. Two stubborn scholars, one dig site.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you gives up the trowel.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn as old stone.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd watch from a safe distance.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a disagreement, that's a lifelong feud.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you is leaving the ruins.
{streakCount} straight clashes with {username}. Someone fetch a mediator and a map.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone feed these two. And separate them.
{streakCount} against {username}. I admire the stamina. Do hydrate.
details: A grudge as old as the ruins.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you've logged nothing. There's still daylight.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your name is missing from the field notes.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. I'd value your findings on this one.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The sun's sinking behind the dunes. Hurry.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me haul you out by the collar.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You've gone quiet. Lost in a tomb?
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The stones are starting to shift.
{timeLeft} left. Torch up, run for it.
Final call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Grab the artefact.
{matchCount} finds still unlogged and the tomb is sealing. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} unanswered matches and the dig is closing. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No entries on {matchTitle}. Someone must break ground.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not one vote logged. I'll wait. Briefly.
A fresh site, untouched sand. Be first to dig.
{matchTitle} is a blank page in the journal. Write the opening line.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new chambers to explore.
{matchCount} matches opened in round {round}. The next layer begins.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} chambers to examine.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Catalogue each with care.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your survey.
{momentTitle} won. A magnificent find.
{momentTitle} is through. Exactly as the map foretold.
{momentTitle} took it. Raise the lantern.
{momentTitle} won and lit up the whole chamber.
{momentTitle} advances. One more piece for the collection.
{momentTitle} moves on. Remarkable.
{momentTitle} lost. A cracked relic.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the discovery I'd hoped for.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Brush off the dust.
{momentTitle} went out in a blaze of dust. That counts.
{momentTitle} is out. Have a biscuit. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A collapsed tunnel, not a lost expedition.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More ruins await.
details: It held to the last stone.

messages: Welcome to the expedition. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
A new recruit. {liveCount} matches are live. Grab a torch.
A new recruit. {liveCount} matches want a decision.
{liveCount} chambers unopened. Choose a door.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Mind the traps.
Day two. You returned to the site. Good.
Two days running. A dedicated digger.
Second day at the site. I checked the roster.
{days} days away. I kept your spot at the fire.
After {days} days you return. The ruins are still here.
{days} days. I'd started to worry. Don't wander off again.
{days} days away. They've opened several new chambers.
You're back. Good.
Welcome back. The dig continues.
Back already. Keen.
Ah. There you are, colleague.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very quiet dig site.
Hardly any visitors at this one. That should change.
Low turnout. Everyone's at the other excavation. Come anyway.
Barely a trowel in the dirt. Someone should pick one up.
details: Every pair of hands counts in the ruins.
Don't let the site go cold.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. You're the deciding discovery.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One more find settles it.
A fork in the tunnel. Someone has to pick a path. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, two doors, equal carvings. Choose.
Still tied and the torches are guttering. One last choice.
Level, with the passage closing. Vote.
Tied, and the door is sealing. Don't leave it unopened.
Still deliberating? The sand won't wait.
Don't overthink it. Pick a passage.
They're all fascinating. Trust your field instincts.
You've lingered at the entrance long enough. Step inside.
details: No wrong tunnel. Only unexplored ones.

messages: First find logged. The expedition has begun.
You made your pick. The journal is open.
details: Entered in the field notes. +{xp} XP
The first of many discoveries. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You've found the trailhead.
Five. No longer waiting at base camp.
Ten votes. The guides all know your name.
Ten. You've earned a bedroll by the fire.
Twenty-five votes. Your voice carries down the canyon.
Twenty-five. The whole caravan hears you.
Fifty votes. Properly part of the expedition.
Fifty. Evidently committed. Approved.
details: Fifty entries in the journal. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes. They'll name a wing of the museum after you.
One hundred. Superb. I'll concede it exactly once.
details: A hundred. Accept the museum's applause. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. A torch catches.
Third day running. Consistent.
details: Showing up is half the dig. +{xp} XP
Three days among the ruins. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's a proper field season.
Seven days on site. Flawless attendance.
details: A week without missing a dig. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. Not one day off the site.
Fourteen days. Faultless timekeeping.
details: A fortnight in the field. +{xp} XP
That's a proper research stint. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. A full season's work.
A month of devotion. The journal approves.
details: Thirty days on the dig. +{xp} XP
A whole month in the ruins. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You follow the forgotten trails.
Five remote hunches. I respect the audacity.
Fifteen underdogs. You leave the marked path.
Fifteen. You follow your own compass.
details: Fifteen votes off the beaten track. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. Nobody can predict your route.
Thirty. You're the unmapped territory.
details: Thirty votes for the buried one. +{xp} XP

messages: First at the site five times. Early.
Five times you beat the crew to the dig.
details: You arrive before the tents go up. +{xp} XP
Five votes ahead of the caravan. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where yours was the first spade in. Decisive.
First one over the threshold, every time.
details: Fifteen entries ahead of the caravan. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole expedition. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Steady hands, every time.
Another close squeeze. Nerve like old bronze.
Twenty-five close matches. Your word keeps deciding them.
You've settled more than one dispute.
details: Twenty-five finishes by a grain of sand. +{xp} XP
You decide which tunnel opens. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you stayed with the buried one. Patient. Good.
You trust a late discovery. Sensible.
details: Five turnarounds you believed in. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. A favourite artefact.
That one again? You've found your relic.
Five visits to one moment. Steadfast.
You won't drop that one. I wouldn't either.
Ten votes on one moment. That's an obsession.
Ten visits to a single pick. I shan't remark. Much.
details: Ten on a single relic. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're sticking to the trail.
Round two and still trekking. Good.
Four rounds. Deep into the ruins.
Well into the bracket. The passages narrow.
Six rounds. You explored the whole complex.
To the final chamber. Never once retraced a step.
details: From the first step to the final chamber. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've surveyed a good few sites.
Ten distinct matches. Methodical. Good.
Twenty-five matches. Every chamber visited.
Twenty-five. Not a corner left unmapped.
Fifty matches. That's no visit, that's a career.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the atlas.
details: A veteran of the whole survey. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting. A long expedition day.
Five consecutively. Please drink from the canteen.
Ten in one go. A marathon dig.
Ten in one stretch. Proper endurance.
Voting at this hour? Studying by lantern light, I assume.
The wee hours. Studious or sleepless. I know both well.
details: A vote after the campfire died. +{xp} XP

messages: You sent word to your friends. Thank you.
Five shares. More diggers, more finds.
Fifteen shares. You're practically the expedition newsletter.
Fifteen. You keep bringing the whole caravan in.
You were here before the first dig. A founding member, always.
One of the first thousand. That can't be erased from the journal.
details: No one takes that from the record. +{xp} XP

messages: A new rank. Properly earned.
Promoted. Wear it like a field commission.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Fascinating.
Another entry for the collection: {name}.
{rank}. Entirely deserved.
You've put in the fieldwork and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. I know someone who's done worse. Frequently.
Ten remote bets. Not one tremor of doubt.
details: Remote hunches are your whole method. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten near calls. You match my steady hand.
Ten narrow finishes. I'm privately pleased.
details: Calm while the walls shake. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven straight days. Your aim holds firm.
Seven days, not one skipped. Well surveyed.
You broke the tie. One squeeze, one verdict.
A stalemate in the ruins, and you chose the passage. Splendid.
details: The entry that settled it. +{xp} XP

messages: Safari Caitlyn, pith helmet on. Rifle ready.
Caitlyn is yours now. Do try to keep up. Mind the traps.

upcoming: Not open yet. The site hasn't been cleared.
Voting hasn't begun. I'll send word when it does.
Not yet. Good discoveries reward patience.
prevote: Two sites, one expedition. Inspect both before you commit.
Look at both before you dig. No rushing into a tomb.
I won't say which I favour. The evidence is yours to weigh.
Take your time. A careful survey beats a hasty one.
Choose the one that makes you want to explore.
prevote-empty: No entries yet. Log the first.
Quiet so far. Someone must break ground.
Not a single vote. Be first.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no entry from you. Move.
The dig site closes soon. Commit.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before the light fails.
voted-early: You voted early with barely anyone here. First to the site.
Hardly a find logged and you'd committed. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Lovely. Sands shift.
{pct}% on your side. A cosy spot in the shade.
A lead is a lead, but the roof can still give. Stay sharp.
voted-close: Razor-thin. One more vote tips it. Fetch a friend.
Shoulder to shoulder. Your pick needs a patron.
voted-tied: Perfectly level. Two passages, no winner.
A dead heat. Maddening, and rather thrilling.
voted-behind: You're outnumbered. That doesn't make you wrong.
{pick} is trailing. A buried gem. I know the type.
They lead. You're not mistaken, merely outnumbered.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Send dispatches widely.
The party went the other way. That settles nothing.
closed-won: Your pick won. A fine call.
{pick} went through. You read the ruins rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick crumbled. Unfortunate. A scholarly choice all the same.
It didn't survive the descent. That happens. Press on.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither passage gave way.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed and you missed this one. More expeditions will follow.
The match is done. {winner} claimed it. Arrive earlier next time.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Everyone's first dig feels tense.
Entry number one. The rest come easier. Trust the process.
You're one of the crew now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you keeping the expedition alive.
You keep returning to the site. I appreciate that.
underdog: You alone chose that one. Logged.
A hard choice. A good one.
The overlooked ruin. That takes backbone.
early: Early. You reached the site before the rest.
Sparse entries so far. Yours will stand out.
close: That entry moved the scale. It hangs by a thread.
A hairline margin. One more vote swings it.
A near thing. Your mark on the map matters.
behind: {pick} lags. Lagging isn't lost. Call for reinforcements.
Not in front yet. Digging remains.
Down, not entombed. There is a distinction.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. Sands shift.
default: Vote logged. There's more to survey.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no entries yet. Start with the one that intrigues you.
Every site is in view. Choose. I won't rush you.
{unvoted} to survey. No pressure. Slight, anyway.
live-some: {voted} logged, {unvoted} still to go. Keep exploring.
A good start. The rest won't excavate themselves.
live-few: {unvoted} chambers outstanding. Finish before the gate shuts.
Almost at the vault. Steady the torch.
live-one: A final match. Don't leave it unexplored.
One match between you and a full survey.
live-closing: A few conclude in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still lack your entry.
The hourglass is draining. {unvoted} to go, {timeLeft} left.
The site is closing. Do hurry.
live-done: All matches voted. Splendid. Study the bracket's layout.
Nothing outstanding. Return when the next round breaks ground.
Every chamber logged. Seldom seen. Respect.
live-none: Nothing's open this minute. It will be. Review the bracket while you wait.
Quiet in the ruins. Check back soon.
No matches are open. I'm pacing the camp as much as you.
brackets-groups: Group stage opens the survey. Two per group descend deeper. The rest turn back.
All enter through a group. Only some reach the inner vault.
Keep an eye on the standings. They slide fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts approach. Only the top two of each group go deeper.
No knockout yet. The groups must be fully excavated first.
Be patient. Knockouts surface when the groups conclude.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are underway. One misstep and the passage seals.
One loss and you're out. No second excavation.
Each match carries more weight now. Tread with care.
brackets-bracket: Round after round. A single loss ends the expedition.
Trace the bracket. Each round the corridor tightens.
Every line records a match somebody surveyed.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for exploring it with me.
It's finished. A hard-fought expedition. I'll miss it.
A champion emerges. A fitting last chamber.
brackets-empty: No bracket on the wall. Nothing's been charted.
Blank chart. The draw isn't mapped yet.
An unwritten page for now. Peek in later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One find decides it. Choose.
Two sites, one pick: {a} against {b}. Cast your vote.
{a} versus {b}. Join the expedition and tell me what you think.
voted: {pick} over {other}, by my notes. And yours?
My vote goes to {pick}, not {other}. Argue the point.
My find: {pick}, not {other}. Care to dispute it?
early: One of the first entries on {pick} against {other}. We need more diggers.
An early mark for {pick} against {other}. Add yours.
{pick} against {other}, practically unvisited. Yours would stand out.
tied: {pick} and {other} are neck-and-neck. One vote tips the stone.
{pick} and {other} are locked at a fork. Choose a tunnel.
{pick} and {other} cling together. Your vote can pry them apart.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes divide {pick} and {other}. Each entry matters.
{pick} against {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Either could emerge on top.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} off {other}. A handful of entries closes the gap.
{pick} sits {voteDiff} under {other}, though the dig is far from done. Back it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} below {other}. Recoverable. Log a vote.
losing-bad: {pick} is {voteDiff} shy of {other}. It needs sponsors.
{pick} lags {other} by {voteDiff}. A find like that merits better. Help.
{pick} is {voteDiff} beneath {other}. Time to turn the tide.
winning-close: {pick} nudges past {other} at {pct}%. Help it keep the edge.
{pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, still fragile. Lend your vote.
{pick} holds {pct}% against {other}. A sliver of a lead.
dominating: {pick} sprints ahead of {other} on {pct}%. Come and see why.
{pick} is on {pct}%. {other} is lost in the sand.
{pick} is well clear of {other} at {pct}%. Add your mark.
